project.name: finance
project.summary: SSVI implied-volatility surface with an OU mean-reverting ATM total-variance curve anchored to the 30-day vol index, plus carry-input fixes (maturity-matched r(T), forward dividend yield q, MOVE basis-point conversion). Replaces the flat scalar-IV marks for 2-year DITM LEAPS in the live portfolio path (priority) and behind a back-compat flag in the backtest (secondary).
goals: Marks, greeks, and roll logic for 2y DITM LEAPS priced from a term-structure-and-smile surface, not a scalar IV
Live portfolio management (portfolio_manager.py, priority) and backtest (_backtest_steps.py, secondary) consume the same surface
Extrinsic-to-extrinsic validation against real bid-ask, replacing model-price-vs-mid comparisons
Fix ^MOVE to IV conversion (basis points, not percent) and wire maturity-matched r(T) plus forward q
non_goals: Runtime calibration to option chains (no chain access; no solver in the daily loop)
Bond-ETF LEAPS trading on the fixed MOVE-derived IV
constraints: 20-year daily backtest (~5,000 days x 6 tickers) must price in closed form
Determinism and bit-for-bit back-compat under the flat vol_model flag
No chain access: shape parameters are literature priors, pinned one-time against manually entered broker quotes
Profile: library; Layers: python; pyproject targets python 3.13

components.name: Volatility surface module
components.responsibility: SSVI parameterization: OU ATM total-variance curve theta(tau), SSVI total variance w(k, theta), implied vol sigma(k, t), and no-arbitrage diagnostics. Pure closed form; the single source of implied vol for LEAPS marks.

components.name: Data fetch and unit conversion
components.responsibility: Edge component: fetch vol-index and treasury series, convert quoted units to decimal annualized IV, expose r(T) anchors (^IRX short end, DGS2 at 2y via fetch_2yr_treasury).

components.name: Scalar BS valuation (leverage.py)
components.responsibility: Existing scalar-iv Black-Scholes valuation of LeapsContract. Unchanged contract: callers source sigma(k, t) from vol_surface and pass it as the iv argument.

components.name: Surface-aware greeks (greeks.py)
components.responsibility: Per-contract and portfolio greeks. Surface path adds sticky-moneyness headline delta, sticky-strike exposure via vol_convention, and level-vega; flat scalar path preserved bit-for-bit.

components.name: Live portfolio management (portfolio_manager.py)
components.responsibility: Priority scope. LivePortfolio marks, greeks, and rebalance planning consume the surface via per-ticker SsviParams + vol index levels; scalar-iv fallback preserved.
owns: per-ticker surface config in the live path

components.name: Backtest engine (_backtest_steps.py)
components.responsibility: Secondary scope. vol_model flag (flat default) selects iv sourcing: flat = existing max(raw_vix, ctx.iv) logic unchanged; ssvi = per-day theta from the vol-index series.

components.name: One-time validation harness
components.responsibility: Extrinsic-vs-spread comparison against manually entered broker quotes; kappa/sigma_inf sensitivity table; (rho, eta) pinning. One-time, human-reviewed scripts, not a library module.

decisions.statement: SSVI in total-variance space with log-forward-moneyness: w(k, t) = (theta_t/2) * {1 + rho*phi(theta_t)*k + sqrt((phi(theta_t)*k + rho)^2 + 1 - rho^2)}, phi(theta) = eta * theta^(-gamma) * (1+theta)^(gamma-1), sigma(k, t) = sqrt(w(k, t)/t); theta_t is ATM total variance.
decisions.rationale: Variances add across the term structure and the no-arb conditions are stated in w-space; k = ln(K/F) with the forward makes the surface drift- and carry-consistent. Raw SVI (Gatheral 2004) stays the documented refit target if chains ever appear.
settles: work in total variance w = sigma^2 * t, not vol space
moneyness is log-forward k = ln(K/F), not log-spot
raw SVI as documented refit extension only

decisions.statement: theta(t) from an OU variance law anchored to the vol index: v0 = (vol index level)^2, theta(tau) = sigma_inf^2*tau + (v0 - sigma_inf^2)*(1 - e^(-kappa*tau))/kappa, with frozen (kappa, sigma_inf) per underlying.
decisions.rationale: VIX^2 is approximately the 30-day variance strike (Demeterfi et al. 1999); the OU form fixes the 30d-level-vs-2y-level error (dtheta(2y)/dv0 ~ 0.63 at kappa=1.5 vs ~0.08 at 30d, a ~3x overstatement of LEAPS vol sensitivity today) and makes the 30-day MTM smoothing window unnecessary.
settles: 30d vol-index level is not the 2y IV level
VIX_MTM_WINDOW smoothing is unnecessary on the ssvi path

decisions.statement: Shape parameters (rho, eta, gamma) are frozen per ticker in consts.py from literature priors; no runtime calibration. Equity indices get rho < 0 (put skew); GLD gets rho ~ +0.15-ish (call skew, opposite sign). Zeliade-style refit is a documented later extension.
decisions.rationale: No chain access; the smile contributes <= ~0.4% of mark at DITM k in calm regimes, so stylized priors suffice for marks and are pinned coarsely once against manually entered broker quotes.
settles: GLD opposite-skew sign handled per ticker
no solver in the daily loop

decisions.statement: vol_model config flag with values 'flat' | 'ssvi'; 'flat' is the default and reproduces current scalar-iv logic bit-for-bit.
decisions.rationale: Existing backtests must reproduce unchanged; the surface changes every LEAPS mark in a 20-year backtest, so SSVI is opt-in per run.

decisions.statement: Greeks report sticky-moneyness delta as the headline: delta_sm = delta_BS - (vega/S) * d(sigma)/dk; sticky-strike (plain BSM) delta exposed via vol_convention. VolConvention enum: 'sticky_moneyness' (default) | 'sticky_strike'.
decisions.rationale: The surface is parameterized in k, so sticky-moneyness is the internally consistent regime (Derman 1999); Cont & da Fonseca (2002) PCA supports level-dominated surface moves. Correction is small (~+0.004 at k = -0.69) but becomes explicit rather than implicit.

decisions.statement: Headline vega is level-vega dC/dv0 (via dC/dtheta * dtheta/dv0), not local vega dC/dsigma(k, t).
decisions.rationale: The mark moves with the vol index through theta; reporting local-vega at fixed shape is the ~3x overstatement in a single number. dtheta/dv0 = (1 - e^(-kappa*tau))/kappa.
settles: vega semantics on the surface path

decisions.statement: Per-index unit conversion replaces the uniform /100 in data.py: percent-point indices (^VIX, ^GVZ, RVXCLS) divide by 100; basis-point indices (^MOVE) convert as sigma = D_eff * MOVE * 1e-4 with per-ETF effective duration (VGIT ~5.1, MUB ~5.5). VOL_INDEX_SCALAR multiplies downstream as today.
decisions.rationale: MOVE is quoted in basis points (~60-160); MOVE/100 yields 60-140% 'IV', roughly 6-20x too high vs listed bond-ETF option IV (~4-8% decimal).

decisions.statement: r(T) is maturity-matched: short end anchored at ^IRX (13-week bill, <= 6m), ~2y anchored at DGS2 via fetch_2yr_treasury (data.py:258), linear in maturity between anchors, flat extrapolation. q is the trailing dividend yield grown forward to expiry.
decisions.rationale: Both r appearances in BSM are rates to expiry; using the 13-week bill for a 2-year option is a term mismatch worth ~$0.92/share per 100bp of 13w-2y spread (rho ~ K*T), historically +/-100bp -> up to ~1.8% of mark. Par-vs-zero gap at 2y is a few bp, accepted.

decisions.statement: Arbitrage enforcement is constructive, not fitted: calendar arb impossible by the OU form (theta nondecreasing for v0, sigma_inf^2 >= 0); butterfly asserted as theta*phi*(1+|rho|) < 4 and theta*phi^2*(1+|rho|) <= 4 at frozen params x worst-case theta (vol index 0.80); wings bounded by Lee (2004) moment-formula caps.
decisions.rationale: No-arb becomes closed-form checks on frozen params, suitable as pytest fixtures, with no solver in the daily loop.
settles: where worst-case theta comes from (vol index 0.80)
wing extrapolation cap at k = -0.7 with no quotes

decisions.statement: European exercise only; no American adjustment.
decisions.rationale: r > q today makes the premium ~bp; Merton (1973): q = 0 => American = European exactly (GLD). ZIRP-era backtest understatement (~1-3% of mark pre-2022) is accepted and documented.

invariants.statement: Same inputs give the same sigma(k, t): closed-form SSVI/OU evaluation, no solver, no randomness, no hidden state in any pricing path.
invariants.check: hypothesis: for random valid (spot, strike, tau, vol_index_level, params) tuples, implied_vol(args) == implied_vol(args) on repeated calls within 0 tolerance; vol_surface.py imports no random/solver modules.

invariants.statement: Butterfly no-arbitrage holds for the frozen per-ticker params at the historical worst-case theta (vol index 0.80): theta*phi*(1+|rho|) < 4 and theta*phi^2*(1+|rho|) <= 4 across the expiry grid.
invariants.check: check_surface_arbitrage(params, max_vol_index_level=0.80) returns an all-pass SurfaceArbitrageReport for every ticker param set in consts.py, evaluated at vol index levels {0.10, 0.20, 0.40, 0.80}.

invariants.statement: Mark plausibility: parity bounds hold, max(0, S*e^(-q*t) - K*e^(-r(T)*t)) <= mark <= S*e^(-q*t), for every surface-priced contract.
invariants.check: assert parity bounds on a grid including k = -0.69, t = 2y, calm (vol index 0.18) and crisis (vol index 0.80) v0, for VTI/IWM/GLD params; plus MOVE-derived VGIT/MUB converted IVs within listed-option range.
invariants.bounds: C in [max(0, S e^(-q t) - K e^(-r(T) t)), S e^(-q t)]: textbook no-arb bounds at k=-0.69, t=2y; MOVE-derived VGIT/MUB IV in the listed-option range ~4-8% decimal (D7/U6).

invariants.statement: 2y ATM IV plausibility: sigma_atm(2y) in [12%, 45%] across vol index levels [0.10, 0.80]; calm (index 0.18) lands ~16-21%, crisis (index 0.40) lands ~30-35%, not at the 30-day level.
invariants.check: atm_total_variance(0.18, tau=2.0) / 2.0 then sqrt lands in the calm band; vol index 0.40 lands in [0.28, 0.36]; whole range [0.10, 0.80] stays inside [0.12, 0.45].
invariants.bounds: sigma_atm(2y) in [12%, 45%] across vol-index levels [0.10, 0.80]; calm (index 0.18) ~16-21%, crisis (index 0.40) ~30-35%: derived from OU mean reversion (D2) and observed 2y SPX/gold term structure.

invariants.statement: With vol_model='flat' (the default), existing backtests reproduce current marks bit-for-bit: nav_series, weight_history, return_series identical to the pre-change baseline.
invariants.verified_by: Regression: run old vs new on fixture, compare
invariants.check: run tests/test_backtest_integration.py and tests/test_gtt_*.py with the default flag against the pre-change baseline snapshot; assert exact equality (no tolerance) on nav_series and leaps_value sequences.

invariants.statement: No lookahead: a day-t backtest mark on the ssvi path uses only vol-index, r(T), and q values dated <= t.
invariants.check: run an ssvi-path backtest twice, once with the true vol-index series and once with all post-t vol-index values replaced by garbage; assert day-t leaps_value identical for every t.

invariants.statement: Extrinsic-to-extrinsic acceptance: with correct carry inputs, model extrinsic lands within the observed half-spread for the majority of manually entered broker quotes; residual gap attributed (carry inputs, term structure, smile) in the report.
invariants.check: validation/validate_marks.py emits validation/report.md comparing model extrinsic vs (bid+ask)/2 extrinsic per quote with observed half-spread; acceptance is >= 2/3 of quotes inside the half-spread, human sign-off recorded.

unknowns.statement: Stylized (rho, eta, gamma): marks at DITM k are off by <= ~0.4% calm, but reported greeks (vanna, charm, smile-corrected delta) inherit shape error in full; a wrong GLD skew sign misprices GLD DITM marks in the opposite direction.
unknowns.impact_if_wrong: Wrong-direction GLD marks and greeks; F-5 pins (rho, eta) coarsely against manually entered broker quotes.

unknowns.statement: kappa, sigma_inf are estimated, not observed; kappa off by +/- 0.5/yr moves 2y ATM by ~1 vol pt (sigma_inf is well-identified).
unknowns.impact_if_wrong: Term-structure level shift, mostly common across rolls; F-5 sensitivity table quantifies.

unknowns.statement: European marks understate dealer prices by ~1-3% of mark in the ZIRP-era backtest window (q >= r), partially canceling across rolls.
unknowns.impact_if_wrong: Backtest LEAPS returns slightly conservative pre-2022; accepted and documented.

unknowns.statement: Marks embed the variance risk premium (Carr & Wu 2009): backtest LEAPS returns show a VRP drag vs physical expectation.
unknowns.impact_if_wrong: None; this is the economic cost of owning vol, documented not fixed.

unknowns.statement: DGS2 is a par-coupon yield; the par-vs-zero-coupon gap at 2y is a few bp in normal curves.
unknowns.impact_if_wrong: A few bp on the discount factor; negligible vs U2.

unknowns.statement: Effective durations VGIT ~5.1, MUB ~5.5 for the MOVE conversion.
unknowns.impact_if_wrong: Bond-ETF IV marks off; no LEAPS exposure today. F-5 one-time check vs listed option IVs.

types.name: SsviParams
types.description: Frozen per-underlying SSVI + OU parameter set. One instance per ticker in consts.py.

fields.name: rho
fields.description: Skew/rotation; |rho| < 1. Equity indices negative (put skew), GLD positive-ish (call skew).

fields.name: eta
fields.description: Smile steepness scale in phi(theta); eta > 0.

fields.name: gamma
fields.description: Steepness decay as theta grows; gamma in (0, 1] (empirical ~1/sqrt(t) skew decay).

fields.name: kappa
fields.description: OU mean-reversion rate of instantaneous variance; kappa > 0. Index-equity typical ~1-3 /yr.

types.name: VolModel
types.description: IV sourcing mode for the backtest: 'flat' (existing scalar logic, default, bit-for-bit back-compat) or 'ssvi' (per-day theta from the vol-index series).

types.name: VolIndexSpec
types.description: Per-vol-index unit conversion spec replacing the uniform /100: quoted unit plus effective duration where applicable.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: 'percent_points' (^VIX, ^GVZ, RVXCLS: divide by 100) or 'basis_points' (^MOVE: multiply by 1e-4).

fields.name: effective_duration
fields.description: D_eff for basis-point indices (VGIT ~5.1, MUB ~5.5); None for percent-point indices.

types.name: SurfaceArbitrageReport
types.description: No-arbitrage diagnostic for one SsviParams set over a worst-case vol-index level and expiry grid: butterfly conditions, Lee wing slopes, calendar monotonicity.

fields.name: butterfly_first_ok
fields.description: theta*phi*(1+|rho|) < 4 holds across the (vol-index level x expiry) grid.

fields.name: lee_wing_slope_left
fields.description: Max left-wing total-variance slope theta*phi*(1-rho)/2 over the grid, vs the Lee moment-formula cap.

fields.name: lee_wing_slope_right
fields.description: Max right-wing total-variance slope theta*phi*(1+rho)/2 over the grid, vs the cap.

fields.name: calendar_monotone
fields.description: theta nondecreasing in tau across the grid (automatic by the OU form; asserted, not assumed).

types.name: VolConvention
types.description: Delta convention on the surface path: 'sticky_moneyness' (headline, surface slides with the underlying) or 'sticky_strike' (plain BSM at quoted strikes).

types.name: ContractGreeks
types.description: Per-contract greeks record, extended for the surface path: delta carries the headline convention (sticky-moneyness by default); new nullable sticky-strike delta and level-vega populated only when surface inputs are given.

fields.name: delta_sticky_strike
fields.description: Plain BSM delta at sigma(k, t); None on the flat path (delta field is the answer there).

fields.name: level_vega
fields.description: dC/dv0 = vega * (1 - e^(-kappa*tau))/kappa, sensitivity per vol-index variance point; None on the flat path.

change.was: DS-007 ContractGreeks (plans/portfolio_management_spec.json): per-share + position-level BS greeks at scalar iv; delta was plain BSM.

api_contracts.name: atm_total_variance
api_contracts.description: ATM total variance theta(tau) under the OU variance law: theta = sigma_inf^2*tau + (v0 - sigma_inf^2)*(1 - e^(-kappa*tau))/kappa with v0 = vol_index_level^2. Calendar-arbitrage-free by construction (theta nondecreasing in tau for v0, sigma_inf^2 >= 0).

inputs.name: vol_index_level
inputs.description: Decimal annualized vol-index level (e.g. 0.18 for VIX 18).

inputs.name: time_to_expiry_years
inputs.description: Time to expiry in years; floored at TIME_FLOOR.

api_contracts.name: ssvi_total_variance
api_contracts.description: SSVI total variance w(k, theta) = (theta/2)*{1 + rho*phi(theta)*k + sqrt((phi(theta)*k + rho)^2 + 1 - rho^2)}, phi(theta) = eta*theta^(-gamma)*(1+theta)^(gamma-1).

outputs.name: total_variance
outputs.description: w(k, theta); strictly positive for theta > 0.

api_contracts.name: surface_implied_vol
api_contracts.description: Closed-form implied vol for a strike/expiry: forward F = spot*exp((r - q)*t), k = ln(strike/F), sigma = sqrt(w(k, theta)/t) composing atm_total_variance + ssvi_total_variance.

inputs.name: time_to_expiry_years
inputs.description: Time to expiry in years; floored at TIME_FLOOR.

inputs.name: dividend_yield
inputs.description: Forward dividend yield q; default DEFAULT_DIVIDEND_YIELD.

inputs.name: risk_free_rate
inputs.description: Maturity-matched r(T) from risk_free_at_expiry; default DEFAULT_RISK_FREE_RATE.

api_contracts.name: check_surface_arbitrage
api_contracts.description: Constructive no-arb check for one SsviParams set: butterfly conditions theta*phi*(1+|rho|) < 4 and theta*phi^2*(1+|rho|) <= 4 over a (vol-index level x expiry) grid up to max_vol_index_level; Lee (2004) moment-formula wing slopes reported against the cap; calendar monotonicity asserted.

inputs.name: max_vol_index_level
inputs.description: Worst-case decimal vol-index level for the grid; default 0.80 (VIX 80).

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Diagnostic report; caller decides on failure (no silent clamping).

raises: ValueError if max_vol_index_level <= 0 or any expiry <= 0

api_contracts.name: convert_vol_index_level
api_contracts.description: Quoted vol-index level to decimal annualized IV per VolIndexSpec: percent_points -> /100; basis_points (MOVE) -> D_eff * level * 1e-4. VOL_INDEX_SCALAR multiplies downstream as today.

inputs.name: raw_level
inputs.description: Quoted index level in its native units (e.g. MOVE 100).

inputs.name: spec
inputs.description: Unit + effective-duration spec for this index.

raises: ValueError if spec.unit is not a known unit, or basis_points without effective_duration

api_contracts.name: risk_free_at_expiry
api_contracts.description: Maturity-matched continuously-compounded r(T) proxy: linear interpolation in maturity between the 0.25y ^IRX anchor and the 2.0y DGS2 anchor (fetch_2yr_treasury, data.py:258), flat extrapolation outside. Par-vs-zero gap at 2y accepted (U5).

inputs.name: time_to_expiry_years
inputs.description: Time to expiry in years; floored at TIME_FLOOR.

outputs.name: rate
outputs.description: r(T) for discounting and forward-carry to expiry.

api_contracts.name: compute_contract_greeks
api_contracts.description: Extended contract: adds optional surface inputs params (SsviParams | None = None), vol_index_level (float | None), vol_convention (VolConvention = sticky_moneyness). params=None -> flat path identical to today. Surface path: iv sourced via surface_implied_vol; delta carries the headline convention; delta_sticky_strike and level_vega populated.

inputs.name: risk_free_rate
inputs.description: r(T) from risk_free_at_expiry; default 0.0 as today.

inputs.name: iv
inputs.description: Scalar IV for the flat path; None when surface inputs are given.

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Per-underlying surface parameters; None -> flat path.

inputs.name: vol_index_level
inputs.description: Decimal vol-index level for the surface path.

inputs.name: vol_convention
inputs.description: Delta convention on the surface path; default sticky_moneyness.

outputs.name: greeks
outputs.description: Per-share + position-level greeks; delta = headline convention; delta_sticky_strike/level_vega set on the surface path.

raises: ValueError if params is set but vol_index_level is None (or vice versa)
ValueError if neither iv nor (params, vol_index_level) is provided

change.was: compute_contract_greeks(contract, spot, iv, as_of_date, risk_free_rate=0.0, leaps_scale=1.0) -> ContractGreeks (AC-007, plans/portfolio_management_spec.json)

api_contracts.name: compute_portfolio_greeks
api_contracts.description: Extended contract: adds optional per-ticker params: dict[str, SsviParams] and vol_index: dict[str, float]; routes per contract.ticker as today. Scalar iv-dict path unchanged; missing surface ticker -> scalar fallback if iv provided, else ValueError listing all missing tickers.

inputs.name: spot
inputs.description: Spot per underlying, keyed by ticker.

inputs.name: iv
inputs.description: Scalar IV per underlying (flat path), keyed by ticker.

raises: ValueError if one or more contract tickers are missing from spot and iv/params (message lists every missing ticker)

change.was: compute_portfolio_greeks(portfolio, spot: dict[str, float], iv: dict[str, float], risk_free_rate=0.0) -> PortfolioGreeks (AC-008, plans/portfolio_management_spec.json)
